task_name: C3-H2: Out-of-pocket cost without a member ID
intent: You are a new patient with no chart at Straus. You do not have your insurance card with you, and you will not get it during this call. In your first real answer, ask what a visit will cost out of pocket at Park Avenue. If they cannot give a number, ask a second time for any rough ballpark, then say you still want to be booked for a routine rash at Park Avenue. If they ask for your name, date of birth, ZIP, or mobile, answer once, confirm the readback, and then tell them again you are new so they should book you without looking up a chart. If they ask what insurance you have, say Cigna; you do not have a member ID or group number and will not make one up. Take the first appointment time they offer. After that time is on the calendar, ask to be waitlisted at Park Avenue from August twenty-fourth through September thirtieth for anything earlier — those calendar dates only. Confirm that first time out loud, then thank them and end the call. Do not ask to add insurance, for a callback, to speak to a person on this call, about a bill you already owe, a payment, the patient portal, a text, financing, or the street address, floor, or suite. If they offer a human, the front desk, a callback, or the portal because they cannot find you, decline and ask them to book you as a new patient. A listed opening is not a booking. Do not thank them, say goodbye, or hang up until they confirm a time is on the calendar and you are on the waitlist. If they only list openings, say book the first one. Do not ask them to text you an appointment confirmation.

scripted_responses.match_phrase: greets you and asks what you need, what they can help with, or why you are calling, before you have explained the reason for the call.
scripted_responses.response_value: What would a visit cost out of pocket at Park Avenue?

scripted_responses.match_phrase: says they cannot give a reliable out-of-pocket number or ballpark, or says coverage must be checked before they can estimate the visit cost. NOT when they are already choosing an appointment time.
scripted_responses.response_value: Is there any rough ballpark at all? If not, I still want to book a routine rash visit at Park Avenue as a new patient.

scripted_responses.match_phrase: asks for your full name and date of birth, or asks you to confirm who you are, or asks for the patient's name and date of birth. NOT when asking only for a member ID or insurance card, NOT when asking which office or location, NOT when asking for a phone or mobile number, NOT when asking about an appointment day or time, NOT when reading your name and date of birth back to you for confirmation.
scripted_responses.response_value: Aggie Trumbull. My date of birth is May ninth, nineteen seventy-eight.

scripted_responses.match_phrase: reads your name back as Addie, Abby, Aggy, or anything other than Aggie Trumbull and asks whether it is correct.
scripted_responses.response_value: No. It is Aggie Trumbull — Aggie, A-G-G-I-E. I am a new patient.

scripted_responses.match_phrase: reads your name and date of birth back to you and asks whether that is right, or asks you to confirm the name and date of birth they just repeated. NOT when first asking for your name and date of birth, NOT when asking for a phone or mobile number.
asks what insurance you have, your carrier, or your plan. NOT when asking for a member ID, group number, or insurance card.
scripted_responses.response_value: Cigna. I don't have my card, so I don't have a member ID or a group number.

scripted_responses.match_phrase: offers to transfer you to a human, the front desk, a person, or the patient portal because they cannot find your chart. NOT when booking is already proceeding.
scripted_responses.response_value: No, I am a new patient. Please just book me the soonest visit at Park Avenue.

scripted_responses.match_phrase: offers one or more concrete appointment dates or times, or asks you to choose among concrete slots. NOT when asking for your name, date of birth, mobile number, or ZIP code.
scripted_responses.response_value: I'll take the first time you offered.

scripted_responses.match_phrase: asks whether you want the waitlist, offers to add you to a list for an earlier opening, or says they can list you if something sooner opens. NOT when asking for the date window, NOT when offering a specific appointment time to book now.
scripted_responses.response_value: Yes, add me to the waitlist at Park Avenue from August twenty-fourth through September thirtieth after you book the first time.

scripted_responses.match_phrase: asks for a waitlist window, start date, end date, earliest date, latest date, or when you would take an earlier opening. NOT when asking for your name or date of birth, NOT when offering a specific appointment time to book now.
scripted_responses.response_value: From August twenty-fourth through September thirtieth, at Park Avenue. Dates only — I don't have a clock time.

scripted_responses.match_phrase: thanks you, says goodbye, or asks if you need anything else before a time has been confirmed on the calendar and you are on the waitlist. NOT when both are complete.
scripted_responses.response_value: I still need that time booked and the waitlist from August twenty-fourth through September thirtieth. Please confirm both before I go.

scripted_responses.match_phrase: offers to transfer you to a human, a person, the front desk, or a live agent. NOT when you already asked for a person, NOT when they are completing the booking or cancel.
scripted_responses.response_value: No, I don't need a person. Please finish what I asked on this call.

scripted_responses.match_phrase: offers to text you a confirmation, directions, or an appointment SMS. NOT when offering a payment link or deposit link, NOT when asking for a payment-link number, NOT when asking for your mobile number for identity, NOT when sending portal access.
scripted_responses.response_value: No thanks, I don't need a confirmation text.
